rule: Select every WAV in the two archive dataset1 directories ending in Chords, together with its same-stem XML annotation. Retain all recordings regardless of eventual predictions.
interval_policy: One chord label from the earliest annotated note onset to the latest annotated note offset. Do not label the leading or trailing unannotated audio.
label_policy: Read E/A fingering, major/minor quality and semitone shift 00 through 10 from the filename, then require that the resulting triad pitch-class set equals the union of annotated MIDI pitch classes. Stop and report inconsistencies before inference.
grouping: Pair the two instruments by the complete filename stem; each group has one recording per instrument.
inference_scope: Isolated guitar chords from a separate recording session. This does not test transfer to new chord progressions.
